units_and_contract.viewport: Window.viewport_size supplies GPUI logical Pixels; display DevicePixels conversion is separate. Text zoom scales facet metrics, not the native window dimensions.
units_and_contract.responsive_room: facet Room design width equals the owning region allocation divided by text_scale; existing DOCK/BAR/ASK/NOTES hysteresis ladders remain the responsive authority.
units_and_contract.drawer: Animate semantic openness0..1 and derive current pixel bounds from that fraction and current drawer width. Closed remains fully outside after resize or zoom; no unrequested pixels, scrim or native targets.
units_and_contract.reader: Root allocations may shrink on both axes; Reader content keeps natural height in one vertical GPUI scroller. Nested source/document table viewports keep their own horizontal scrolling.
units_and_contract.overlays: Ask text and controls use the full results-content allocation from AskScene, while the occupied animated rectangle and preview remain sourced from AskGeometry. Graph captions use Reader allocation.
units_and_contract.documents: Markdown block renderer receives container width through TextViewStyle/MarkdownRenderContext from the Reader Measure. Immutable Markdown extension and document identities remain unchanged; style width changes reuse parsed documents.
units_and_contract.optional_rust_status: Both installed-toolchain status and missing-toolchain remediation retain centered wrapping text with max_w_full and min_w(0), so their intrinsic text width cannot exceed the Home allocation. No path or remediation text is removed.
units_and_contract.document_selection: Full TextViewStyle equality and selection_revision invalidation remain intact. Container width can change custom-heading typography even at unchanged outer bounds; the adapter stores coordinate endpoints and block keys rather than stable character offsets. Current-frame registration alone does not prove saved selection remains valid after reflow. Selection persistence across allocation changes is not accepted by this source repair.

source_specific_hypotheses.confirmed_by_code: The old closed over-x track targets minus drawer pixel width. Zoom changes that target without opening the drawer, animating it across the viewport edge and mounting a false departing drawer.
source_specific_hypotheses.shared_width_mismatches: Ask, graph captions and custom README headings formerly borrowed whole-window width; their enclosing plate/Reader allocations can be narrower. They now consume the owner allocation.
source_specific_hypotheses.vertical_reachability: Home and Settings already use Reader scroll; natural-height and min-width constraints are explicit in the repair. Their lower content needs native scroll reachability verification.
source_specific_hypotheses.motion_selection: appearance builds the requested radio selection from snapshot.settings.motion; direct Full/Reduced pixels match saved preferences. No speculative preference invalidation fix is applied.
source_specific_hypotheses.shelf_action: Shell.toggle_shelf uses persisted inline preference in wide mode and transient drawer state in narrow mode. The four GUI27 Shelf frames exercised wide-mode collapse only.
source_specific_hypotheses.blank_ask: Empty query paints input and veil; no typed result, publication, compilation, graph, history or restart evidence exists.
source_specific_hypotheses.selection_safety: Source inspection includes TextView.render style inequality, TextViewState.on_prepaint size/revision fences, selection_adapter update_layout_revision, and base TextSelection frame-generation registration and coordinate endpoint resolution. Existing same_size_style_reflow_invalidates_finished_selection and replacement/append controls must retain their behavior; no vendor selection contract is weakened.
